deadline.value: Apply by December 1 for the best chance (review starts then, rolling admission); the final deadline is March 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: Applicants are encouraged to apply by December 1st for the best chance of admission. | The final deadline for applications is March 15, 2027.

gre_general.value: The department requires the GRE General Test from the 2027-28 application cycle.
gre_general.quote: Effective for the 2027-28 application cycle, the Department of Chemistry requires the GRE General Test.

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry Subject GRE is not required.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Subject Test is not required.

funding.value: All admitted students are offered financial support (stipend, tuition, fees, health insurance) for the normative 5 years; first-year students are funded as teaching assistants.
funding.quote: all admitted students are offered financial support for the program's normative time to degree.

also.quote: Chemistry Ph.D. students are funded as teaching assistants during their first year

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT overall 80, plus Speaking 26+ (tests before 21 Jan 2026) or 5 (on or after) for TA eligibility.
toefl_min.quote: an overall score of 80 or higher for admission

ielts_min.value: IELTS overall 7, Speaking 8, and 6 in the remaining modules.
ielts_min.quote: an overall score of 7 or higher to be admissible

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Applicants choose an area of interest; the ChAMP-Chemistry route is a separate application. Supervisor and entry route are not stated on the pages checked.
